title: 1 Year subscription - Going downhill
text: I was excited when we got our first subscription. It came in a box. That was the first and last time it came in that size. The second month it was delayed, took almost 6 weeks to arrive. It came in an envelope packet and every month after that. You get a letter, a coin, a sticker page, a small toy, and a small pamphlet every month. They used to send a luggage tag but that stopped. Tried to cancel but I bought a one year subscription and they’ll only change my status to non-renew. Either I gift the remainder of the months to someone else or keep it. Not worth the monthly fee AT ALL.
label: negative
